findings.resolution: Retained knowledge.canonical-ontology and knowledge.evidence-graph as FOUNDATION. The current source maps without vocabulary gaps but its records remain UNVERIFIED until the upstream deterministic producer emits honest per-record envelopes and trusted-behavior equivalence is proven. Owner: source.contract-ingestion; acceptance: confirmed nodes/edges carry artifact, extractor, snapshot and trusted hash without test injection.

Unverified nodes are now emitted only as UNVERIFIED context with every trust gap and cannot create ImpactFinding or TestSelection objects; raw HUMAN_CONFIRMED remains untrusted without a separate approval receipt.

EvidenceRetriever binds one cached normalized graph, project, source snapshot, raw graph digest and ontology/profile identity at service construction; runs and analysis use that binding, with post-construction mutation coverage.

The source profile is independently digest-pinned, adapter/schema-bounded and gives each raw relation its own legal endpoint subset. Duplicate JSON keys, cross-signature use, paired semantic rehash and incompatible source versions fail closed.

AssuranceRun now declares schema 2.0.0 and binds raw/canonical graph identities; pre-A1 documents load explicitly as schema 1.0.0 with unavailable identities and remain subject to the effective fail-closed decision view.

Propagation now recomputes normalized graph and result/path digests, validates IDs/endpoints/relations, requires every receipted seed/target/edge source hash to equal the trusted raw-graph digest, and binds project, raw graph, snapshot, ontology, profile and policy identities through traversal and the independent risk-evaluation boundary.
Path limits now bound deterministic frontier enumeration rather than trimming after enumeration; every limit emits a blocking gap, and risk abstains when propagation has a blocking gap.

Recorded as a truthful FOUNDATION boundary. Owner: reasoning.directional-propagation; acceptance: typed factor observations bind target, project, snapshot, request/change intent, evidence, extractor and observation validity; forged or lowering substitutions abstain.

Recorded as a truthful FOUNDATION boundary. Owner: reasoning.directional-propagation; acceptance: hop receipts bind observation and validity times to an explicit evaluation time and reject expired, future or cross-snapshot evidence before workflow integration.
The non-bypassable governance 2.x interlock remains unchanged and forces INCOMPLETE; A1/A2 analysis work does not claim completion of R0 release-evidence prerequisites.
